bio: Indulge in an exquisite Afternoon Tea experience at art’otel London Battersea Power Station served every Saturday and Sunday from 12pm- 4pm in the sophisticated setting of JOIA Bar with views overlooking the iconic chimneys of Battersea Power Station.  Relax and unwind while savouring a delightful array of sweet and savoury treats including scones with strawberry jam, lemon curd & clotted cream, sandwiches with smoked salmon, cucumber, dill & cream cheese all perfectly complemented by our extensive selection of teas.  Guests can choose the Champagne afternoon tea option for £65pp. To celebrate Afternoon Tea week from 12th - 18th August the venue will also be offering guests our Gin & Tea O’Clock cocktail with Plymouth Gin, pink grapefruit & peppercorn, earl grey and topped with Bubbles for £16.  Gluten-free options are available with 48 hours' notice.
